text: I need your decision. I started the live-betting change you asked for: a middle tier where Live light also bets when its model is 80-89% sure, at 10-cent real stakes. My safety layer then blocked me from continuing, and I stopped. The edits were auto-saved to main before I could check them: they are untested and not compiled, and the engine runs from main, so its next start could pick them up. I also half-reverted the work: two files are restored and two still carry the edit, so the tree is inconsistent. Say 'continue' and I'll finish and test it, or 'revert' and I'll restore the files from commit 878fd09dd. Until then, treat main's live code as unverified. The SX/Polymarket mapping answer (names match; props missing on SX) is unchanged and nothing there was edited.
